source.principal_scale_definition: withdrawal_amount >= 16 ETH; conservative protocol-scale proxy, not an exact full-exit label
source.availability: completed UTC hour plus fixed 180 seconds
required_conservation: principal rows plus partial rows equals all withdrawal rows
principal ETH plus partial ETH equals all withdrawn ETH
global withdrawal indices remain unique and contiguous

economic_screen.event: completed stream hourly ETH amount at or above its prior-only rolling 720-hour 90th percentile
economic_screen.entry: first observable one-minute open after source availability plus fixed 500ms order latency
economic_screen.long_geometry: completed event-hour low structural invalidation and prior-only 24-hour high objective
economic_screen.short_geometry: completed event-hour high structural invalidation and prior-only 24-hour low objective
economic_screen.gap_stop: observed one-minute open when beyond the structural stop
economic_screen.stage_boundary: mark and stop new entries; never strategy-close; training excludes unresolved labels
economic_screen.model: eight fixed-seed event-bootstrap HGBT regressors of direct 24bp account action value; score is mean minus 0.5 standard deviation

requirements: principal-scale ML policy ends above 10000 USDT in development and confirmation
principal-scale exact positive-winner deletion and full rerouting ends above 10000 USDT in both forward stages
principal-scale policy exceeds the identically evaluated partial-reward control in both forward stages
no forced liquidation or prohibited elapsed-time exit

prohibitions: no change to the 16 ETH source split after market outcomes
no threshold, rolling-window, quantile, source-delay, action-geometry, cost, risk or leverage rescue
no 2024-2026 opening unless the frozen pre-2024 pass rule is met
